# runpod_serverless_endpoints (Data Source)

All Serverless endpoints owned by the authenticated account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_serverless_endpoints" "all" {}

output "endpoint_names" {
  description = "Endpoint names, keyed by endpoint id."
  value       = { for e in data.runpod_serverless_endpoints.all.endpoints : e.id => e.name }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) One entry per Serverless endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `endpoint_type` (String) Request routing: QUEUE or LOAD_BALANCER.
- `id` (String) Endpoint identifier.
- `image` (String) Docker image reference for workers.
- `name` (String) Endpoint name.
- `request_urls` (Attributes) Invocation URLs the API reports for this endpoint, the same set the runpod_serverless_endpoint resource reports. A QUEUE endpoint fills the job operations (run, run_sync, status, stream, cancel, retry, purge_queue, health); a LOAD_BALANCER endpoint fills base and health, since its remaining paths are worker-defined. The attributes that do not apply to the endpoint's routing type are null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--request_urls))
- `workers_max` (Number) Maximum number of workers.
- `workers_min` (Number) Minimum number of workers.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--request_urls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.request_urls`

Read-Only:

- `base` (String) Base URL for the worker's own HTTP and WebSocket paths. LOAD_BALANCER endpoints only.
- `cancel` (String) Cancel an in-progress job or drop a queued one. Takes a job id in place of the {job_id} segment.
- `health` (String) Operational status of the endpoint, or the path the load balancer polls for worker health.
- `purge_queue` (String) Drop all pending jobs from the queue, leaving in-progress jobs running.
- `retry` (String) Requeue a failed or timed-out job. Takes a job id in place of the {job_id} segment.
- `run` (String) Submit a job asynchronously.
- `run_sync` (String) Submit a job and wait for its result.
- `status` (String) State, timings, and result of a submitted job. Takes a job id in place of the {job_id} segment.
- `stream` (String) Read incremental results from a job that produces output progressively. Takes a job id in place of the {job_id} segment.
